parts.label: (a)
parts.text: A network of three resistors of resistances $R_1$, $R_2$ and $R_3$ is shown in Fig. 6.1. {{figure:fig_6_1}} Fig. 6.1 The individual potential differences across the resistors are $V_1$, $V_2$ and $V_3$. The current in the combination of resistors is $I$ and the total potential difference across the combination is $V$. Show that the combined resistance $R$ of the network is given by $$R = R_1 + R_2 + R_3.$$

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: A battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $8.0\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance is connected to a thermistor, a switch X and two fixed resistors, as shown in Fig. 6.2. {{figure:fig_6_2}} Fig. 6.2 Resistor $R_1$ has resistance $6.0\text{k}\Omega$ and resistor $R_2$ has resistance $4.0\text{k}\Omega$.
parts.text: Switch X is open. Calculate the potential difference across $R_1$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Switch X is now closed. The resistance of the thermistor is $12.0\text{k}\Omega$. Calculate the current in the battery.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: The switch X in the circuit in (b) remains closed. The temperature of the thermistor decreases. By reference to the current in the battery, state and explain the effect, if any, of the decrease in temperature on the power produced by the battery.

marking_points.text: (resistance) increases so total resistance increases so) current decreases (in battery)
